Name: ✒︎ 001 · UI · ImprovedUI & ImpUI ❧
Description: A load order divider to simplify Mod organization.
Author: Astralities

Name: ImpUI (ImprovedUI)
Description: NOT MAINTAINED - An official updated version of ImpUI for Patch 8. Contains some UI changes from previous versions, as all other UI changes are now officially supported in the base game. Use only if other mods utilise, otherwise can be removed.
Author: bibsan (prev. Djmr / AlanaSP / ShinyHobo / Zee)

Name: ✒︎ 002 · UI · Caites' UI Mods ❧
Description: A load order divider to simplify Mod organization.
Author: Astralities

Name: NoIntro
Description: Skips splash animations.
Author: Caites

Name: No Press Any Key Menu MCM
Description: Skips waiting for your input after Baldur's Gate splash animation loaded and instantly loads main menu. KB/M and controllers compatible. MCM compatible.
Author: Caites & Volitio

Name: BetterHints
Description: Replaces vanilla hints with tidbits about game lore - short, 1-2 lines long, mostly about locations, orgs and deities of Faerun.
Author: Caites

Name: NewLoadingScreens
Description: Replaces 13 vanilla loading screens with 60 new ones from the official artbook. Mod is not yet official.
Author: Caites

Name: Better Map 120
Description: Improves minimap and journal map. Minimap is scaled to 120%, draggable, icons are better visible, zoom works better. Journal map got legend and waypoints list rework. Links to different versions in full description on mod.io.
Author: Caites

Name: Clear Map
Description: Annoying grid on the map and minimap removed, fog of war is slightly transparent. KB/M and controllers compatible.
Author: Caites

Name: BetterMapAssets
Description: Assets for Better Map.
Author: Caites

Name: Better Containers 5x5
Description: QoL changes to containers: bigger grid, renders next to character menu, fixed sizer, additional info about container and items inside. 5x5 KB/M version. Just bigger, 10x8, grid for contollers. KB/M and pads compatible.
Author: Caites

Name: BCPP 16x9 4 5x10
Description: Improves character sheet panel and TAB party panel. Version for 16:9 aspect ratio, shows 4 characters on the screen in party panel. KB/M only.
Author: Caites

Name: Better Split Item
Description: Makes split item menu more responsive, adds min/max buttons to instantly choose 1 item or the whole stack and highlights target amount text to make it more clear. Only KB/M meny changed.
Author: Caites

Name: Better Trade Menu
Description: Increases grids and allows to drag multiple items/stacks in Barter Mode. Trade Mode allows to sell items from Camp Chests and companions in camp.
Author: Caites

Name: Trade With Anyone
Description: Allows you to trade with any NPC you can talk to. KB/M compatible only.
Author: Caites

Name: Better Combat Log Default
Description: Makes combat log tighter and draggable. Adds autohide toggle. KB/M version only. Requires Improved UI.
Author: Caites

Name: Better Hotbar [Vova's Edition]
Description: This mod is a lot like 'BetterHotbar2' with some changes. Includes fixes and tweaks to flaws in vanilla Hotbar. For ANY screens(16:10, 16:9, UW), Numbers of slots depends on screen aspect ratio(4x19+2, 4x24+2, 4x38+2), GridSize(100%).
Author: Vova2112

Name: Dynamic Sidebar
Description: Dynamically scales sidebar portraits to let them fit the screen without scrolling. Up to 16 chars. 2 rows status holder, autohider. Supports companions panel from CPCCE. KB/M and pads compatible (static 10 chars version for pads). Requires ImpUI.
Author: Caites

Name: Better Topbar
Description: Improves initiative tracker - makes it tighter and adds more info about combatants. KB/M and gamepads compatible. Requires Improved UI. For 16:9 (and UW) aspect ratio.
Author: Caites

Name: Better Target Info
Description: Adds more contextual info to Target Info panel (resistances/vulnerabilities, item value, number of items in containers etc). KB/M and pads compatible. Links to different versions in full description on mod.io.
Author: Caites

Name: Better Context Menu 130%
Description: Conext Menu improvements: 35+ icons for contextual actions, clean panel and better visible highlighting when hovering over the lines instead of arrow icon, faster animations. KB/M and gamepads compatible. 130% scale.
Author: Caites

Name: Damage Preview
Description: Improves cursor text panel - adds damage numbers, damage type icons and warns about replacing concentration spell. KB/M only. Requires Improved UI.
Author: Caites & Noxis

Name: CPCCE
Description: Improves Companions Panel, makes it (and Camp Chest) available from anywhere. KB/M compatible. Dynamic Sidebar is suggested to get access to Companions Panel button in a wild. Requires ImpUI.
Author: Caites

Name: Better Various Widgets
Description: An assortments of fixes and improvements for 5 small widgets not worthy of standalone mods: Combine, Reward Panel, Make Camp, Tadpole Powers Tree and Reaction Decision Popup. KB/M compatible.
Author: Caites

Name: Better Dyeing
Description: Makes all dyes reusable and alters Combine widget with dyeing in mind - its instant, it allows consequent dyes without opening/closing panel and it changes combine button to reduce mouse movements.
Author: Caites

Name: BetterTooltips
Description: Adds approval rating to companion's summary tab, 19 new item categories in tooltips, scroll's spell description, weapon proficiencies icons and fixes for statuses. KB/M and pads compatible. Requires ImpUI.
Author: Caites and juumeijin

Name: ✒︎ 003 · UI · Caites' Better Inventory UI ❧
Description: A load order divider to simplify Mod organization.
Author: Astralities

Name: Better Inventory UI
Description: Makes inventories easier to read and organize. Adds new mini-icons, back and foregrounds to distinct useful loot from trash. Load order suggestions in full description. Links to different versions in full description on mod.io.
Author: Caites

Name: AddonBetterInventoryUI
Description: Adds more categories with numerous items (like food and dyes) in performance-friendly way. Use with or without Better Invenotory UI.
Author: Caites
